findAddEquivalence.finding: Same existing canonical LM search/projection path; full accepted-registration equivalence is not implemented and cannot be asserted.
findAddEquivalence.structure: LM SeedParticipant uses entityType, status, localities/mapLocalities and public sources. Platform Participant uses kind, slug, places and verified. There is no production acceptance-to-LM dataset writer in the inspected release.
findAddEquivalence.status: This record remains located. Platform registration accepted is a review lifecycle state, not LOCATED or ACTIVE; its development canonical writer creates verified:false participants.
findAddEquivalence.provenance: LM retains public sources and historical populationSources; registration separately retains user/assisted field provenance, reviewer decisions and private contacts. This enrichment creates none of those claims.
findAddEquivalence.search: Exact Te Mata Park Trust searches use EXISTING_MATCH/ENDORSE_EXISTING routing; Te Mata Park uses possible-match review. Routing is not an endorsement. Platform projectParticipant publishes only verified participants. Unscoped token matching also returns two unrelated candidates for Te Mata Park; the exact Trust name and Hawke’s Bay-scoped Park query resolve to the retained identity. These are search false positives, not duplicate Te Mata identities.
findAddEquivalence.projection: Manifest -> regional JSON -> buildParticipantRegistry -> locatedParticipants -> searchParticipants -> existing participant panel. Full source arrays remain in JSON; the runtime projects only the first sourceUrl. No per-record rendering or search code.
findAddEquivalence.capabilities: Find/Add Add currently displays a registration handoff message without persistence/admission. Platform acceptance service requires a canonical writer and creates an authority relationship; only an in-memory writer is present and service calls occur in tests. This located enrichment grants no user authority, verification, ACTIVE state or participation.

validation.participantValidator: All 17 manifest datasets plus changed resolved source: zero errors; existing region-only notices retained.
validation.legacyScan: A broader non-manifest scan also included historical public/data/participants-auckland.json, which has 100 pre-existing status != located errors. It is not a production manifest input and is unchanged.
